plan: Deep-copy the input recipe so neither adapt nor print_original mutates arguments; print_original returns authored_text verbatim.
Compute one Fraction scale factor (target_yield / recipe yield) applied to every quantity, including substitution-introduced additional ingredients.
Index the catalog into a per-name candidate list sorted by (priority, catalog index) for deterministic selection with catalog-order tie-breaking.
Resolve each ingredient with a while-loop substitution chain guarded by a lineage set: repeated name -> 'substitution cycle involving NAME'; no candidate -> 'no substitution for NAME'.
Recursively resolve substitution-introduced additional ingredients under the same exclusions/catalog and lineage, supporting chained adaptations and reintroduced exclusions.
Accumulate wording-change pairs and apply them as ordered str.replace edits to instruction strings (recipe and components); accumulate equipment adds/removes into a working list.
Check final equipment against available_equipment item-by-item, adding 'equipment NAME unavailable' per miss; collect all reasons in a set and keep processing so every independent reason is reported.
Assemble the result dict: possible/recipe/choices (application order)/warnings (sorted)/reasons (sorted); recipe null on impossibility, equipment sorted and yield set to target on success.

Embed the executable acceptance contract as an __main__ assertion suite covering scaling 3->5, chained substitution, verb+equipment change, reintroduced exclusion (failing and chained-success variants), cycle, multiple simultaneous reasons, byte-exact original print with non-mutation, and priority determinism.
